caption: This drawing features several outlined shapes representing sewing pattern pieces, each labeled with alphanumeric designations such as "B-1 2," "B-2 2," "A-4," "A-3 2," "A-2 4," and others. The objects are drawn in black ink on a light beige background. There are also several sets of dashed or dotted lines on some pieces, as well as arrows and solid lines indicating direction or fold lines. One piece at the bottom right (labeled A-3 2) is drawn with a series of closely spaced, slightly curved dashed lines and annotation showing locations for "TOP" and "BOTTOM." The composition is organized neatly, spreading the pattern pieces out with space between them, filling almost the entire page. Labels and short instructions or descriptions are written beside or inside the shapes in a plain, handwritten style. At the bottom of the page, there is a block of text explaining the use and construction of the various pieces, detailing how the shapes fit together, where to sew or pleat the fabric, and other assembly notes, all written in uppercase letters. The primary visual elements are the outlined pattern shapes, their annotations, and the instructional text block.
title: Description of a Wedding Dress
